Hi Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the files. Looping in Kimberly from AP so she has visibility on bank/PO routing. A couple quick clarifications before we create the vendor master: 

1) Legal entity confirmation: you listed "Greenshore Logistics, Inc." — can you confirm that the legal entity on the W-9 exactly matches this and that there are no alternate legal names or holding entities we should be aware of? If you have a certificate of incorporation or a copy of the IRS EIN confirmation that helps speed verification.

2) Beneficial owner / UBO: do you have the name(s) of any 25%+ beneficial owners for entity validation? If the company is privately held we need the UBO name(s) for our vendor file.

3) PO contact vs AP contact: you listed Elena as AP. For PO creation: who should be the PO recipient at Greenshore (name/email/phone)? If you prefer the PO to route to a purchasing inbox, we can map POs to that address separately from AP.

4) Bank verification: the remit image is helpful. For final activation our finance team typically needs either (a) a bank letter on bank letterhead confirming the account, or (b) a micro-deposit verification flow. Either is fine — please indicate preference.

5) Tax documentation: W-9 looks valid at first glance. Can you confirm the EIN format (no spaces or extra characters) and the tax classification?

I attached our vendor onboarding template (pre-filled where possible) — please sign and re-send. Once we receive the incorporation/EIN proof and the preferred PO recipient, finance will create the vendor record; typical SLA is 2 business days after complete docs are received.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Template_filled.pdf
